3490-4050-6824-8333.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4050-6824-8333.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Sickbay triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding one mana of any color
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

553-6108-7468.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using High Fae Trickster.
In response, cast Swat Away by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

4377-7722-7843.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Elrond.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Walk the Aeons from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Walk the Aeons from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

364-1987-5913.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
364-1987-5913.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Pinnacle Monk
When Pinnacle Monk enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
364-1987-5913.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

uses.n: Brigid, Clachan's Heart // Brigid, Doun's Mind

3457-7203-7791.description:
Activate Brigid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G} or {W}{W}
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Brigid
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Brigid
Repeat.

3617-7309-7722.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Time Walk, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Don & Leo.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Time Walk from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Time Walk from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

1267-2438-4034.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1267-2438-4034.description:
Declare Yore-Tiller Nephilim as an attacker.
Yore-Tiller Nephilim triggers, returning Medomai from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using Medomai, triggering its ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Medomai.
Repeat each turn.

1988-2921-3490-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
1988-2921-3490-7426.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Blade of the Bloodchief triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1251-2011-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1251-2011-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Najeela as attackers.
Najeela triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
1251-2011-3259.notes: Najeela can make additional Warriors if you attack with multiple each iteration. Najeela doesn't have to attack after the first iteration, as the Warrior token will trigger it.

1456-4871-5220-6798.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
1456-4871-5220-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

1659-6797-7084.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Seed the Land triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

539-1669-7031.description:
Cast Badgermole by paying its mana cost
When Badgermole enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Badgermole
When Badgermole dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Badgermole enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Thaumatog ability.
Repeat from step 3.

628-5147-6863--133.notablePrerequisites: Blue has a -1/-1 counter on it.
628-5147-6863--133.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the other Dinosaur.
When the Dinosaur dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to the -1/-1 counter it will gain from Blue.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.
628-5147-6863--133.notes: The chosen Dinosaur must not be a Human for the combo to work. Notably, this means you cannot use a creature with changeling for this combo.

4067-4182-6745.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven artifacts. Uthros has twelve or more charge counters on it.
4067-4182-6745.description:
Activate Uthros by paying {U} and tapping it, adding at least seven {U}.
Cast Whispers of the Muse with buyback by paying {5}{U}, causing you to draw a card and return Whispers of the Muse to your hand.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Uthros.
Repeat.

1399-1606-3664-5929.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Lotus Field.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

372-390-4681.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Hulking Metamorph.
372-390-4681.description:
Cast Hulking Metamorph by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Put the original Abdel Adrian into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing Karmic Guide to return to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide and Hulking Metamorph's abilities trigger.
Resolve the Hulking Metamorph ability, choosing to exile Karmic Guide until Hulking Metamorph leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Hulking Metamorph into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing Karmic Guide to return to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide and Abdel Adrian's abilities trigger.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian ability, exiling Karmic Guide until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Hulking Metamorph from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 2.

64-1987-4276-5913.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
64-1987-4276-5913.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Pinnacle Monk and Warden of the Eye.
When Pinnacle Monk and Warden of the Eye enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
64-1987-4276-5913.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

586-2906-5258-5618-5686.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 1 life this turn.
586-2906-5258-5618-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1018-4872-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Time Warp and Skullwinder each turn.
1018-4872-6122.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Skullwinder by paying its mana cost.
When Skullwinder enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Skullwinder from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

283-2113-3995.notablePrerequisites:
Illusionist's Bracers and Karametra's Favor attached to Horseshoe Crab.
Horseshoe Crab does not have summoning sickness.
283-2113-3995.description:
Activate Horseshoe Crab by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Horseshoe Crab by paying {U}.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Horseshoe Crab's ability.
Resolve the copy of Horseshoe Crab's ability, untapping it.
Activate Horseshoe Crab by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
 Resolve Horseshoe Crab's ability from step 2, untapping it.
Repeat.

2034-2732-2781.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, triggering its ability, targeting Prowling Geistcatcher.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Felidar Guardian, adding {C}{C}.
Prowling Geistcatcher triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian from your graveyard.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger from 2, blinking Prowling Geistcatcher.
Prowling Geistcatcher leaves the battlefield, returning Felidar Guardian from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

228-1778-3701-4763.description:
Equip Skullclamp to Memnite for {0}.
Memnite dies.
Skullclamp triggers, drawing you 2 cards.
Koll triggers, returning Memnite to your hand.
Cast Memnite.
Repeat.

1591-2159-3090-3591.description:
Cast Harmless Offering by paying {2}{R}, giving Necropotence to an opponent.
The opponent skips their draw step due to Necropotence.
The opponent is unable to cast any cards put into their hand from Necropotence due to Teferi only allowing them to cast spells at any time they cast a sorcery.
At the beginning of each end step, Sire of Insanity triggers, causing all players to discard their hands.

3652-4050-4314-5105.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ornithopter, adding {W}.
Pawn of Ulamog and Sigil of the New Dawn trigger.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Resolve the Sigil of the New Dawn trigger, causing you to pay {1}{W} to return Ornithopter from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Repeat.

45-364-1987-2556.description:
Activate Khalni Gem by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Khalni Gem and Mnemonic Wall, blinking them.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Khalni Gem enters the battlefield, return two lands you control to your hand if able.
Repeat.

92-558-2298.notablePrerequisites: Each opponent has a life total that is less than forty.
92-558-2298.description:
Activate Vizkopa Guildmage by paying {1}{W}{B}, causing each opponent to lose life whenever you gain life this turn.
Activate Carrion Howler by paying 1 life.
Repeat step 2 until you have one life.
Resolve all Carrion Howler abilities, giving itself +2/-1 for each ability.
Cast Oketra's Last Mercy by paying {1}{W}{W}, causing your life total to become forty.
Vizkopa Guildmage triggers, causing each opponent to lose thirty-nine life.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.
